name: FronTalk
intro: FronTalk 是一个面向前端开发的多轮对话式代码生成基准，强调文本与视觉反馈共同驱动的多轮实现过程，并通过智能体式网页探索评估功能正确性与用户体验。
build_method: 真实网站多轮对话整理, 用户模拟器生成文本和视觉指令, 人工精炼测试用例
modality: 文本, 图像, 代码
task_type: 前端代码生成, 多轮软件工程
eval_feature: 多模态反馈, 智能体评估, 遗忘分析
intro_en: FronTalk is a front-end development benchmark for conversational code generation with multi-turn interaction and multimodal feedback.
build_method_en: Curated multi-turn dialogues from real websites, generated textual and visual instructions with user simulators, manually refined test cases
task_type_en: Front-end Code Generation, Multi-turn Software Engineering
eval_feature_en: Multimodal Feedback, Agent-based Evaluation, Forgetting Analysis

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2601.04203. FronTalk curates 100 multi-turn front-end development dialogues from real-world websites sampled from the C4 corpus. Website summaries are clustered, representative websites are manually selected, GPT-4o generates user intents and verifiable test cases, and manual refinement removes or edits hallucinated, ambiguous, or unverifiable tests. Textual and visual user simulators adapt intents into context-aware instructions; a web-agent evaluator interacts with rendered websites to measure pass rate, forgetting rate, and usability. The final dataset contains 100 dialogues, 1,000 turns, and 3,676 refined test cases.
